name: Hokuyo UST-10LX
description: Industrial 270° 2D scanning laser rangefinder with 10 m range, 40 Hz scans and Ethernet output, IP65.

specs.label: Range
specs.value: 0.06–10 m (white Kent sheet), 0.06–4 m (10% reflectance); max detection 30 m

specs.label: Scan rate
specs.value: 25 ms per scan (40 Hz), motor 2400 rpm

specs.label: Interface / power
specs.value: Ethernet 100BASE-TX; 12/24 V DC (10–30 V), ≤150 mA (450 mA at start-up); sync output + IP-reset input

envelope.axes: x = width, y = depth (cables exit the rear), z = height from the bottom face to top

features.label: Bottom mounting
features.value: 2× M3 depth 6 and 2× Ø3 depth 2.8 (locating) on a 40 × 40 square centred on the 50 × 50 base (M3 at one diagonal pair, Ø3 pins at the other, per the drawing).

features.label: Rear mounting
features.value: 2× M4 depth 6 in the rear face, 42 apart, 17.5 above the bottom face.

features.label: Optical centre height
features.value: 47.4 mm above the bottom face ('Reception part'); optical window 28.7 tall above the 35 mm base.

features.label: Cables
features.value: Rear cable plate: Ethernet (300 mm) and power/IO flying leads (1000 mm, AWG28) on glands 11.5 apart; plate 24 wide; cable exit 2.8 behind the body.

notes: Official CAD exists but is behind Hokuyo's member registration — a human with an account should download 3DCAD(STEP)_UST-10LX/20LX(-H01) from the product page's Downloads tab. Specification PDF and instruction manual are also member-only, so specs and dimensions come from the public product page and its External dimension image (saved as ust-20lx_dw.png; the drawing covers UST-10LX/20LX). The drawing's M3 vs Ø3 assignment to the two diagonal pairs is read from the image; confirm against the STEP.
